name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – After § 34 – Am 13
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 34b. Insists that all agricultural products imported from Mexico must be subject to systematic and binding controls at EU borders to verify full compliance with EU sanitary, phytosanitary and production standards, and that products that do not meet these standards must be refused entry into the EU market without exception; considers that the principle of reciprocity must be the cornerstone of any agricultural trade arrangement, and that European producers must never be placed at a structural competitive disadvantage as a result of this Agreement;
